description:
Then She Was Gone by Lisa Jewell, explained portrait by portrait: who replaced Ellie, and why the reader is fooled.

Producer's note: "Most reviews focus on Laurel's grief, but Hanna's bond with Theo Goodman, the forgotten sister, is the key overlooked part of the family's silent trauma."

Ten years after fifteen-year-old Ellie Mack walked to the library and vanished, her mother meets a charming man in a cafe whose nine-year-old daughter looks exactly like Ellie.

This video walks through Lisa Jewell's Then She Was Gone as a gallery of ten portraits: Ellie, Laurel, Hanna, Paul, Theo, Poppy, Sara-Jade, Blue, Noelle and Floyd. The plot of the crime only appears where two portraits touch.

We follow how each person grabs a replacement for the lost girl, why the reader is fooled the same way Laurel is, what Floyd's so-called atonement really costs, and whether the final scene on the bus is healing or one more substitution. Spoilers for the whole novel, including the ending.
